description: Upload an Android app file (.apk, .aab, .apks, .xapk or .apkm) from disk to the user's TapTry account and get a link anyone can open to run the app in their browser. This publishes the app under the user's name: ask the user before uploading, and say whether it will be public (shown on their profile, anyone can run it), unlisted (listed nowhere, anyone with its secret link can run it) or private (only them). Uploading again with the same `ref` replaces that app's file and keeps its link - prefer that over creating duplicates. Every upload is malware-scanned first; the link only works once status is CLEAN, which can take a few minutes.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the app file, e.g. app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk.

name.description: App name. Default: from the file name.

ref.description: A stable id for this app, e.g. the repo name, so re-uploads update it instead of creating a new app.

visibility.description: Default public. Unlisted suits a build to share with specific people.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the checks before returning (0-600, default 90). Use get_status after that.

name: upload_app
title: Upload an app to TapTry
